-- Compiled proof, equivalent to #print DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows_implies_Publishable
theorem DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows_implies_Publishable :
∀ [inst : DY.BytesFunctor] [inst_1 : DY.ExecTraceTypes] [inst_2 : DY.ProofTraceTypes] [inst_3 : DY.TraceInvariant]
  [inst_4 : DY.BytesInvariants] [DY.BytesInvariantsProofs] [inst_6 : DY.AttackerKnowledge]
  [inst_7 : DY.BaseAttackerKnowledge] [inst_8 : DY.AttackerKnowledgeTheorem] [DY.BaseAttackerKnowledgeTheorem]
  (b : DY.Bytes) (tr : DY.ProofTrace), DY.Trace.Invariant tr → b.AttackerKnows (DY.Trace.erase tr) → b.Publishable tr
:=
fun [DY.BytesFunctor] [DY.ExecTraceTypes] [DY.ProofTraceTypes] [DY.TraceInvariant] [DY.BytesInvariants]
    [DY.BytesInvariantsProofs] [DY.AttackerKnowledge] [DY.BaseAttackerKnowledge] [DY.AttackerKnowledgeTheorem]
    [DY.BaseAttackerKnowledgeTheorem] b tr h_tr =>
  DY.Bytes.AttackerKnows.is_least_fixpoint (fun x => x.Publishable tr) b (DY.Trace.erase tr)
    (fun b => DY.SubAttackerKnowledgeTheorem.pf b tr h_tr) fun b =>
    id (DY.Trace.BaseAttackerKnows_implies_Publishable tr b h_tr)
